Hands-on farming experience at Tra Que Village
html:
Discover the authentic soul of Hoi An beyond its ancient streets. Operated by Vietlook Travel, this immersive half-day tour lets you live like a local, combining hands-on craftsmanship and traditional farming experiences. Create your own colorful lantern, learn the art of cultivation at Tra Que Vegetable Village, and enjoy local cuisine straight from the source.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Hands-on lantern-making workshop – create a unique souvenir with your own story woven in silk and bamboo

  • Become a real farmer at Tra Que Vegetable Village, experiencing organic herb cultivation

  • Learn to prepare local delicacies, including a traditional Vietnamese pancake demonstration

  • Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant

ITINERARY

Morning

  • 08:30: Hotel pick-up by Vietlook Travel guide and transfer to the lantern workshop

  • Hands-on workshop: craft your own Hoi An lantern

Late Morning – Early Afternoon

  • Visit Tra Que Vegetable Village

  • Experience daily farming life and learn to cultivate herbs that define Vietnamese cuisine

  • Participate in a local food demonstration

  • Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch at a local restaurant

13:30

  • Return to your hotel

  • End of tour services.

Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel.

TOUR PRICE: USD 52 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off by air-conditioned coach

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Lantern-making workshop

  • Hands-on farming experience at Tra Que Village

  • Local food demonstration

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Bottled water

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Services not mentioned above

  • Tax
outline: Day 1: LANTERN MAKING - BE A REAL FARMER AT TRA QUE VILLAGE
